subject: Immediate action: your mailbox was flagged
body: Our monitoring system has flagged unusual sign-in activity on your mailbox and we have temporarily limited some features. To restore full access you must complete the verification wizard within 30 minutes. The wizard will ask you to confirm your mailbox recovery settings. If you do not complete verification, we will apply a mandatory password reset and freeze outbound email for 24 hours. This restriction has already been applied to some colleagues this week, so please take the wizard seriously.
indicators: requests recovery/verification outside the real portal
hook: Weaponizes fear of a real security incident and offers a fictional internal precedent, making the deadline feel genuine.
